Past perfect · 易错辨析: The past perfect expresses an action completed before a past reference point: by the time / before / after.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:had + past participle indicates 'past of the past'。

had + past participle|often with by the time, before, after, when|emphasizes the sequence of two past actions|the negative is had not (hadn't) + past participle|in reported speech, the past simple moves to the past perfect
